historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission accepted the Italian Consul General's offer of a monument to Christopher Columbus in the panoramic circle on Telegraph Hill, leaving the choice of sculpture to the Art Commission.

The Recreation and Park Commission agreed that the road up Telegraph Hill to Coit Tower be dedicated as an open public street, and asked the Director of Public Works to start the proceedings before the Board of Supervisors.
